g.text: One pipeline, every topic: building a reliable invoice-extraction system
model is trained to respect — beats markdown/dashes.
wrap the job in <instructions>, the invoice
tags are clarity, NOT injection defence.
each source gets its own labelled block so
output can be attributed to the right document.
attribution is a STRUCTURE problem, not model size.
an example fixes format, tone, reasoning
& scope at once; anchors the FIRST output token.
few-shot = 2+; more is NOT linearly better.
inputs; put the BEST example LAST (recency weight).
contamination — fix by REMOVING the bad
example, never by instructing around it.
reason about tax lines before totalling.
lives in PROMPT TEXT, no API flag; and it
does NOT help creative / simple-lookup tasks.
internal reasoning via API; set type
raise effort for a 40-line invoice with
thinking tokens are BILLED + count against
first token. Format-anchoring ONLY — never refusal bypass.
Steer via system prompt / structured outputs / strict tools.
set tone + format defaults in system prompt;
put "just this once, as a table" in the user turn.
NOT a blanket removal. Don't oversteer (conflicting signals).
old dials for randomness; current models
REJECT non-default values with a 400 error.
instead of temp 0, ask plainly for
temp 0 was never a universal safe default.
dialogue beats one prompt when ambiguous,
ask ONE targeted question, not an intake form.
re-anchor framing each turn; partial reset
reset BEFORE the window truncates silently.
JSON during generation — no parse/retry loop.
mark PO optional (not every invoice has one);
required field with no data → hallucinated value.
only an enforceable SUBSET compiles; SDK
maximum:100 not enforced by decoding; enum is.
match the input schema (name, types, required present).
tool call — no string to parse.
structured outputs shapes the TEXT reply;
strict tools shape the ARGUMENTS. Often use BOTH.
re-include the invoice text; correct ONLY the
failing field; cite the source line per field.
validating at the END with no re-prompt path;
temperature reduction does NOT fix grounding gaps.
gates decide pass/block; bounded retries with
stop after N retries → route to human review.
BREAKS on a safety refusal or a max-tokens cutoff.
Always check stop_reason before trusting the payload.
Red path = retry loop back into
separate passes each catch a different
error class — generate, then critique, then refine.
pass 2 checks totals add up; pass 3 checks
stacking passes on low-stakes work = wasted cost.
each partition (A-H) is a phase of
Domain 4; the red arrows are the validation retry loops.
